title: resolution
tagline: Why New Year Resolution doesn't work? Create a task and challenge yourself. Donation and getting rewards!
description:
Create a task and challenge yourself. Donation and getting rewards! After user login with wallet, they can create task and pledge certain tokens to donate to charity if they failed to complete the task. If they completed the task, they will get certain meme tokens as rewards!

The apps show how much had donated to charities, DAOs and how much meme tokens user had earned.
how_its_made: ConnectKit is straightforward and easy to integrate for most evm-compatible wallet extensions. It reduced the time that I need to integrate with different wallet extensions and errors handling. With wagmi and viem, it makes all the signing and executing way easier compared to the ethersjs and web3js.
